$comment: 编辑用分块，由 build.py 拼进 request.schema.json。

insertHyperlinkOp.limits: docx：段落链在该段已有内容之后插入一个 w:hyperlink，内含一个带 text 的 run。 外部链在该部件 .rels 上新建 Type 以 /hyperlink 结尾的关系，TargetMode 为 External，Target 为 url 原文。内部链写 w:anchor，不写关系。 url 与 anchor 同时出现或一个都不给报 InvalidField。url 为空串报 InvalidField。anchor 为空串或以 _ 开头报 InvalidField。 找不到段落报 IdNotFound。
insertHyperlinkOp.limitsEn: docx: for a paragraph link, insert a w:hyperlink after that paragraph's existing content, containing one run that carries text. An external link creates, on that part's .rels, a relationship whose Type ends with /hyperlink, with TargetMode External and Target the url verbatim. An internal link writes w:anchor and writes no relationship. url and anchor both present, or neither given, returns InvalidField. An empty url returns InvalidField. An empty anchor, or an anchor that starts with _, returns InvalidField. A missing paragraph returns IdNotFound.

setHyperlinkOp.limits: docx：段落链：url、anchor、text、tooltip 至少给一个。url 与 anchor 不能同时出现。 给了 url：有已有 r:id 则改该关系 Target；没有则新建关系并写 r:id，去掉 w:anchor。给了 anchor：写 w:anchor，去掉 r:id，该关系无人引用则删除。 text 只改该 w:hyperlink 内可见 w:t（规则与 setParaText 第 2–4 条相同，范围限于该元素）。tooltip 为字符串则写属性；为 null 则去掉属性。 找不到报 IdNotFound。
setHyperlinkOp.limitsEn: docx paragraph link: give at least one of url, anchor, text, and tooltip. url and anchor cannot both appear. If url is given and an r:id already exists, update that relationship's Target; if there is no r:id, create a relationship, write r:id, and remove w:anchor. If anchor is given, write w:anchor, remove r:id, and delete that relationship if nothing references it. text changes only the visible w:t inside that w:hyperlink (same rules as setParaText rules 2–4, limited to that element). A string tooltip writes the attribute; null removes it. A missing id returns IdNotFound.

deleteHyperlinkOp.limits: docx：段落链拆掉 w:hyperlink 外壳，留下内部 w:r。该 r:id 在本部件 XML 里无人引用则删除关系。 DrawingML 链去掉 a:hlinkClick 和无人引用的 hyperlink 关系，不删对象。 找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是超链接 id 且不是带链的本期 DrawingML 对象 id 报 InvalidId。 对 OLE id 报 InvalidId。
deleteHyperlinkOp.limitsEn: docx: a paragraph link unwraps the w:hyperlink and leaves the inner w:r. If that r:id is unreferenced in this part's XML, the relationship is deleted. A DrawingML link removes a:hlinkClick and any unreferenced hyperlink relationship, and does not delete the object. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is neither a hyperlink id nor a linked DrawingML object id supported in this phase returns InvalidId. An OLE id returns InvalidId.
